var prototype = { inherited: 7 };
var object = { __proto__: prototype, first: 10, second: 20 };
for (var key in object) {
  console.log(key + ':' + object[key]);
}
var last = 'unchanged';
for (last in {}) {
}
console.log(last);
var destination = {};
for (destination.key in { a: 1, b: 2 }) {
  console.log(destination.key);
}
function makeReader() {
  var reader;
  for (var name in { x: 1, y: 2 }) {
    reader = function () {
      return name;
    };
  }
  return reader;
}
console.log(makeReader()());
